vide.titre: Schema in place, reference data not loaded
vide.aide: The data layer is migrated, but no nutrient reference is stored yet. Nothing to fix: they arrive with the next batch.

erreur.titre: The data layer is not responding
erreur.aide: The database is stopped or unreachable. In development, start it again with the db:up command, then refresh.

authentification.aide: The route that publishes it is restricted to authenticated accounts. The database itself is responding normally: nothing to restart.
